summary.text: Kate Lalley is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-6 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Deb Mayfield.
She is a regional planner with a background in landscape and urban design.

paragraphs.text: Kate Lalley was born in Washington, D.C., and lives in Vermont.

She graduated from Immaculata Preparatory School in 1980, earned a B.A. in English from Kenyon College in 1984, and received a master's in landscape architecture from the University of Virginia in 1992.
Her career experience includes working in landscape and urban design and as a regional planner.
Lalley assumed office on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
